_notes: Silverpine rebuild boss / named-rare loot (2026-10-23). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make).

Old Hob.name: Hob's Gnawed Collar
Old Hob.flavor_text: Spiked leather, chewed through at the clasp. He got out. He did not stay out.

Old Hob.name: Farthing Hound-Hide Jerkin
Old Hob.flavor_text: Cured from a dog that never learned to fear a pitchfork.

Old Hob.name: Boneyard Dog-Tooth Dirk
Old Hob.flavor_text: A canine fang the length of a hand, set in a farmhand's knife handle.

Old Hob.name: Mud-Caked Hunter's Boots
Old Hob.flavor_text: Silent on wet earth. Loud, somehow, in every other way.

Gaunt the Scarecrow-King.name: Straw-King's Hollow Crown
Gaunt the Scarecrow-King.flavor_text: Woven from stalks of the Dead Field. It whispers in the voice of the harvest.

Gaunt the Scarecrow-King.name: Gaunt's Threshing Flail
Gaunt the Scarecrow-King.flavor_text: Two sticks, one chain, and a very long grudge against anything that grows.

Gaunt the Scarecrow-King.name: Crow-Feather Cloak
Gaunt the Scarecrow-King.flavor_text: Black feathers, sewn in rows. Some of the rows are still muttering.

Gaunt the Scarecrow-King.name: Burlap Belt of Binding
Gaunt the Scarecrow-King.flavor_text: Rough-spun sacking, knotted tight. It remembers what it was tied around.

Orchardkeeper Gnarl.name: Gnarl's Windfall Staff
Orchardkeeper Gnarl.flavor_text: Apple-wood, split by lightning, healed over with something that is not bark.

Orchardkeeper Gnarl.name: Rotapple-Studded Bracers
Orchardkeeper Gnarl.flavor_text: Dried fruit and bark, bound with root. They smell sweeter than they should.

Orchardkeeper Gnarl.name: Orchard-Warden's Heartwood Shield
Orchardkeeper Gnarl.flavor_text: A slice from the old tree's heart. It has grown a little since you picked it up.

Orchardkeeper Gnarl.name: Malden's Last Harvest Ring
Orchardkeeper Gnarl.flavor_text: A band of polished root. Planted, it would probably grow.

Longleg the Stalker.name: Longleg's Venom-Barbed Spear
Longleg the Stalker.flavor_text: A leg-spine as long as a man, hollow, and still weeping.

Longleg the Stalker.name: Skitterer's Silk Leggings
Longleg the Stalker.flavor_text: Woven in the dark, soft as breath, and sticky in ways that do not wash out.

Longleg the Stalker.name: Stalker's Carapace Pauldrons
Longleg the Stalker.flavor_text: Chitin plates laced with web. Each one is a different shade of wrong.

Longleg the Stalker.name: Dark-Eyed Fang Pendant
Longleg the Stalker.flavor_text: Eight small eyes, polished, set in a single fang. It does not like being worn.

The Forsaken Watchman.name: Watchman's Rusted Lance
The Forsaken Watchman.flavor_text: Still sharp at the tip. The rest of it has given up.

The Forsaken Watchman.name: Raven Hill Warden's Plate
The Forsaken Watchman.flavor_text: Rust-red plate, dented from holding a gate that was never going to be attacked.

The Forsaken Watchman.name: Cemetery Keeper's Gauntlets
The Forsaken Watchman.flavor_text: Gloves for digging and for not digging. They are good at both.

The Forsaken Watchman.name: Sentinel's Grave-Ward Signet
The Forsaken Watchman.flavor_text: An old guard's seal. It keeps the quiet dead quiet.

Muckmaw.name: Muckmaw's Gnashing Jaw
Muckmaw.flavor_text: An entire crocolisk jaw on a bone haft. It still snaps.

Muckmaw.name: Mire-Slick Hide Vest
Muckmaw.flavor_text: Black, scaled, and never dry. It repels water and sympathy equally.

Muckmaw.name: Shadowspring Algae Bracers
Muckmaw.flavor_text: Green, slimy, and curiously healing. Do not ask where they were cut.

Muckmaw.name: Swamp-Tooth Totem Charm
Muckmaw.flavor_text: A tooth the size of a thumb, strung on mud-rope.

Tusk-Mother Gorra.name: Gorra's Tusk-Splitter
Tusk-Mother Gorra.flavor_text: A tusk the length of a forearm, hafted on a fence-post. It has already split something.

Tusk-Mother Gorra.name: Boarhide Greaves
Tusk-Mother Gorra.flavor_text: Thick, bristled, and stiff as a plank. Warm in winter and loud in a stairwell.

Tusk-Mother Gorra.name: Sow-Mother's Girdle
Tusk-Mother Gorra.flavor_text: Woven rope and a chewed brass buckle. It has fed a very large family.

Tusk-Mother Gorra.name: Bristle-Studded Bracers
Tusk-Mother Gorra.flavor_text: Every bristle is a small warning. You've been warned.

The Bloated One.name: Bloated One's Gut-Splitter
The Bloated One.flavor_text: A rusted cleaver, bloated at the blade with something that won't scrape off.

The Bloated One.name: Swollen Mire-Robe
The Bloated One.flavor_text: Soaked, stretched and glowing faintly green. It has a pulse.

The Bloated One.name: Marsh-Gas Pendant
The Bloated One.flavor_text: A vial of something that was never meant to be bottled. It whispers.

The Bloated One.name: Rot-Taut Waders
The Bloated One.flavor_text: Skin-tight, damp, and permanently smelling of the pond floor.

Gnawbone the Foreman.name: Foreman's Bone Pick
Gnawbone the Foreman.flavor_text: A pick carved from a femur. The foreman insisted on the finest materials.

Gnawbone the Foreman.name: Deep Elem Hardhat
Gnawbone the Foreman.flavor_text: Battered iron over padded leather. It has survived three cave-ins and a mutiny.

Gnawbone the Foreman.name: Foreman's Tally Ring
Gnawbone the Foreman.flavor_text: Engraved with every ore cart he ever lost. It's a long list.

Gnawbone the Foreman.name: Pit-Stained Work Gloves
Gnawbone the Foreman.flavor_text: The thumbs are sewn from different hands entirely.

Deathguard Captain.name: Deathguard Captain's Longsword
Deathguard Captain.flavor_text: Issued in the Rotunda, carried since the Third War, never once sheathed.

Deathguard Captain.name: Captain's Gorget of Duty
Deathguard Captain.flavor_text: A gorget engraved with a motto in Common that no one now remembers.

Deathguard Captain.name: Deathguard Plate Cuirass
Deathguard Captain.flavor_text: Black plate, rimed with frost. The plume is still crisp.

Deathguard Captain.name: Field-Commander's Signet
Deathguard Captain.flavor_text: The ring of an officer who never stopped holding the line.

Drowned Ferryman.name: Ferryman's Waterlogged Oar
Drowned Ferryman.flavor_text: It pulls at your arms. It still wants to be in the water.

Drowned Ferryman.name: Lakewater Cloak
Drowned Ferryman.flavor_text: Dripping, even when dry. The drip is a clock.

Drowned Ferryman.name: Fare-Collector's Pouch Belt
Drowned Ferryman.flavor_text: Still heavy with coins from passengers that never reached the other bank.

Drowned Ferryman.name: Mooring-Rope Bracers
Drowned Ferryman.flavor_text: Tarred hemp wound over wet leather. Knots that never slip.

Lord Godfrey's Remnant.name: Godfrey's Pistol-Cane
Lord Godfrey's Remnant.flavor_text: A noble's walking cane with a barrel hidden in the shaft. Its last shot is still loaded.

Lord Godfrey's Remnant.name: Pyrewood Lord's Surcoat
Lord Godfrey's Remnant.flavor_text: Embroidered in a house colour no one can name any more.

Lord Godfrey's Remnant.name: Remnant's Signet of Silverlaine
Lord Godfrey's Remnant.flavor_text: A cracked signet. The seal depicts a wolf and a tower.

Lord Godfrey's Remnant.name: Godfrey's Gloves of Courtesy
Lord Godfrey's Remnant.flavor_text: Fine white calfskin, stained at the cuffs. They were removed for violence.

Berard the Forgotten.name: Berard's Grief-Wrought Staff
Berard the Forgotten.flavor_text: He carved it to remember something. It has forgotten what.

Berard the Forgotten.name: Wraith-Thread Robe
Berard the Forgotten.flavor_text: Spun from a mourning shroud. It is warmer than it looks, and quieter.

Berard the Forgotten.name: Forgotten Warder's Greaves
Berard the Forgotten.flavor_text: Plate that has stood in the rain for a century. It has not noticed.

Berard the Forgotten.name: Talon-Stone Amulet
Berard the Forgotten.flavor_text: A grey stone that remembers every name carved on the hill.

Bloodmaw the Alpha.name: Bloodmaw's Fang-Cleaver
Bloodmaw the Alpha.flavor_text: A single, huge fang, set in a handle of bound sinew. It is not subtle.

Bloodmaw the Alpha.name: Alpha's Pelt Mantle
Bloodmaw the Alpha.flavor_text: Grey and black, still warm. Wolves leave you alone, for the wrong reasons.

Bloodmaw the Alpha.name: Peril-Hunter's Boots
Bloodmaw the Alpha.flavor_text: Quiet in the brush. Loud in the memory of whatever caught the last wearer.

Bloodmaw the Alpha.name: Packleader's Claw Charm
Bloodmaw the Alpha.flavor_text: A claw on a thong. Somewhere nearby, something raises its head.

Gilnean Wall-Warden.name: Warden's Greymane Halberd
Gilnean Wall-Warden.flavor_text: The blade is stamped with a lion's head. The shaft is worn smooth by a very long watch.

Gilnean Wall-Warden.name: Wall-Sworn Tower Shield
Gilnean Wall-Warden.flavor_text: A slab of old Gilnean iron with an inscription: 'None shall pass, in or out.'

Gilnean Wall-Warden.name: Sentinel's Stone-Plate Pauldrons
Gilnean Wall-Warden.flavor_text: Weathered like masonry. They hold the line, and say nothing of it.

Gilnean Wall-Warden.name: Gilnean Border-Seal
Gilnean Wall-Warden.flavor_text: A heavy signet of the wall's own guard. It was never meant to be taken off.

Magister Quillfire.name: Quillfire's Arcane Quill
Magister Quillfire.flavor_text: It writes in light. Only the light knows what it's written.

Magister Quillfire.name: Ambermill Magister's Robes
Magister Quillfire.flavor_text: Violet, silver-trimmed, scorched at the cuff. The scorches are deliberate.

Magister Quillfire.name: Waygate-Touched Circlet
Magister Quillfire.flavor_text: A band of silver wire. When you close your eyes you see a door.

Magister Quillfire.name: Mill-Tower Spellbinder's Ring
Magister Quillfire.flavor_text: Etched with a half-finished incantation. Finishing it is not recommended.
